entities.name: Replayed UE additional security capability
entities.description: Information element included by MME when initiating SECURITY MODE COMMAND during attach or tracking area updating procedures if certain conditions are met.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to attach to the network.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to update its tracking area information.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by MME to initiate security mode control procedure.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: UE additional security capability
entities.description: Information element indicating UE's additional security capabilities.

entities.name: MME supports handling of UE additional security capabilities
entities.description: Condition that MME must support handling of UE additional security capabilities.

entities.name: UE additional security capability IE present in request
entities.description: Condition that ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message included UE additional security capability IE.

relations.description: SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains the Replayed UE additional security capability IE when conditions are met.
Inclusion of Replayed UE additional security capability IE is guarded by MME support condition.
Inclusion of Replayed UE additional security capability IE is guarded by presence of UE additional security capability in request messages.
ATTACH REQUEST message may contain UE additional security capability IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message may contain UE additional security capability IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND is initiated during attach procedure.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND is initiated during tracking area updating procedure.
